## Context

The fixture-admission runner (`src/rebar/llm/evals/fixture_admission.py`, epic REB-693 / 67aa) scopes out container criteria (G3/G4/decomp-shape) as `container-material-unrecoverable`: the replay corpus (`src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/corpus.py`) persists a review's children as bare ticket-id strings only (`_child_ids`), with no per-child title/description. The live plan-review container finder reads each child's full title/description at review time (`context_assembly.py` fetches every child via `show_ticket`), and G3's coverage-discharge cannot fire on an impoverished roster. A container case rehydrated from the corpus therefore runs the finder over material that is not faithful to the historical review. `material_fingerprint` hashes children by id only (`material_diff.py`), so it cannot detect the loss.

## Approach

Extend the plan-replay corpus sidecar to persist per-child at-review material as a new `children_material` field containing `{canonical_id, title, description}` records while preserving the existing `children` field as bare child-id strings.

Implementation details:

- Extend `_reconstruct_material` (and its known consumer `tier2.py::_reconstruct_child`) to reconstruct `title` as well as `description`: start from the child's CREATE `data["title"]`, then apply EDIT `fields["title"]` events up to `review_ts` using the same timestamp gating / last-write semantics already used for description.
- Thread the full per-ticket event mapping returned by `_load_ticket_events` into `_build_sidecar_row`; do not try to reconstruct child material from the parent ticket's `by_type` events. For each `_child_ids(reviewed_related_material)` entry, look up the child's own events and reconstruct that child's title/description as of the parent review timestamp.
- Persist the legacy `children` / `_child_ids` bare-id list unchanged, and add the new `children_material` field during new corpus capture so old consumers (`tier2.py`, sampling, and existing selectors) keep working while container replay has faithful inputs.
- Rehydrate container contexts from `children_material` into the `{ticket_id, title, description}` records consumed by the container finder; non-container consumers continue to see `children` as ids.
- Treat missing or unrecoverable child material as unrecoverable, not as an empty/degraded roster. That includes legacy rows that predate the new per-child material field and child histories whose CREATE event or title/description cannot be reconstructed at `review_ts`.
- Remove the container scope-out in `fixture_admission.run_admission` only after the rehydration path can supply faithful child material or explicitly withhold the case.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/corpus.py`: reconstruct and persist per-child review-time title/description in `children_material` while keeping `children` as ids for fingerprint and legacy consumers.
- `src/rebar/llm/evals/fixture_admission.py`: stop withholding G3/G4/decomp-shape cases solely because they are container criteria once `children_material` is faithful.
- `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/tier2.py`: adapt to the title-bearing `_reconstruct_material` tuple while keeping its `row["children"]` input as bare ids.
- `tests/**` covering synthetic child histories, legacy rows, unrecoverable child material, and container admission dispatch.
- Generated G3/G4/decomp-shape eval spec artifacts only if a live admission run mints changed faithful specs within the existing fixture-admission budget.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The corpus sidecar row preserves `children` as bare ids and persists per-child `children_material` `{canonical_id, title, description}` reconstructed at `review_ts`; a unit test over synthetic child histories asserts CREATE title/description and EDIT title/description updates are reflected as of the parent review timestamp.
- [x] `_build_sidecar_row` receives the full per-ticket event store from `_load_ticket_events` and reconstructs each child from the child's own events, not the parent's events.
- [x] Rehydrated container cases pass `children_material` title/description records to the finder and G3/G4/decomp-shape are no longer withheld as `container-material-unrecoverable` solely because they are container criteria.
- [x] A child whose at-review material is unrecoverable, and any legacy corpus row missing the new `children_material`, withholds that case to drift as unrecoverable rather than calling the finder with an empty/degraded child roster.
- [x] The existing protection for non-container criteria and rows with no children is unchanged.
- [x] A live admission run for G3/G4/decomp-shape either mints faithful specs or records a bounded, explicit no-change/unavailable result in the existing fixture-admission ledger. The spend cap is the existing admission ledger cap enforced by `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/ledger.py`; the ledger must show the run stayed within that configured cap.

## Definition of Done

`make lint`, `make typecheck`, targeted plan-replay/fixture-admission tests, and `make test` pass. The Gerrit change receives LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, is submitted, and this ticket closes after the merged commit is reachable from `origin/main`.

## Plan-review clarification (2026-09-09)

Child title/description are intentionally outside the existing `material_fingerprint` basis today: that fingerprint hashes child identity only, which is the defect this ticket addresses for container admission rather than changing the signed plan-review attestation model. Faithfulness of the newly persisted child material is therefore established by deterministic replay, not by the old fingerprint: the implementation must reuse the same timestamp-gated CREATE+EDIT last-write-wins reconstruction semantics that are already trusted for parent description material, extended to include `title`, and AC1's unit test must prove CREATE title/description plus pre-review EDIT title/description are reflected while post-review edits are ignored. The unrecoverable-withhold path remains for missing CREATE events, malformed event histories, missing persisted child material in legacy rows, or any other case where this replay cannot produce a faithful child `{canonical_id, title, description}` record.

## Verification checklist

- [x] `pytest tests/unit/llm/evals/plan_replay/test_corpus.py -q` (or the existing nearest plan-replay corpus test module) covers per-child CREATE/EDIT reconstruction and legacy/unrecoverable withholding.
- [x] `pytest tests/unit/llm/evals/test_fixture_admission.py -q` (or the existing nearest fixture-admission test module) covers G3/G4/decomp-shape dispatch with populated child title/description.
- [x] `python -m rebar.llm.evals.fixture_admission ...` live admission records either changed faithful specs or an explicit ledger/drift no-change outcome within the existing ledger cap.
- [x] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `make test PYTEST_WORKERS=2` pass before Gerrit upload.
